Workflows.title: credit_card_limit_1
Workflows.goal:
Use these values

Field	Value
Username	demo.user
Password	Demo1234
OTP code	123456
Demo card	Demo Credit Card **** 1234
Requested limit	7500
Pending trigger	9999 (forces pending result)


Scenario Description:


## H1 — Happy path: full auth chain + credit-limit-style flow + success

**Goal:** Splash → version check → login → OTP → 3 popups → Dashboard → menu → flow → submit → success → home.

1. Launch app. Wait for `splash_title_text` to be visible.
2. Wait for Version Check: `version_check_next_time_button` visible.
3. Tap `version_check_next_time_button` (or `version_check_update_now_button` — both navigate to Login).
4. On Login: type `demo.user` into `login_username_input`, type `Demo1234` into `login_password_input`, tap `login_submit_button`.
5. On OTP: type `1` into `otp_digit_1_input`, `2` into `otp_digit_2_input`, …, `6` into `otp_digit_6_input`. Tap `otp_verify_button`.
6. Legal popup appears (title text `Demo Terms`). Tap `popup_legal_accept_button`.
7. Reminder popup appears (title text `Reminder`). Tap `popup_reminder_later_button`.
8. Notifications popup appears (title text `Enable Notifications`). Tap `popup_notifications_not_now_button`.
9. Verify Dashboard Home: `dashboard_greeting_text` text equals `Hello, Alex`.
10. Verify `dashboard_recent_list` is visible and contains 3 rows after the ~400 ms loading state.
11. Tap `dashboard_menu_button` (hamburger).
12. Verify Menu screen: `menu_action_increase_limit_button` visible.
13. Tap `menu_action_increase_limit_button`.
14. Verify Card Selector: `card_selector_recycler` visible with 3 rows.
15. Tap the row whose `card_selector_card_masked_number_text` equals `**** 1234`.
16. Verify Limit Value Entry: `limit_entry_selected_card_text` contains `**** 1234`. `limit_entry_current_limit_text` shows `5000 demo`. `limit_entry_available_limit_text` shows `2500 demo`.
17. Type `7500` into `limit_entry_value_input`. Tap `limit_entry_continue_button`.
18. Verify Agreement: `agreement_checkbox` visible and unchecked.
19. Tap `agreement_checkbox`. Tap `agreement_continue_button`.
20. Verify Review: `review_selected_card_value_text` contains `**** 1234`, `review_requested_limit_value_text` equals `7500`, `review_agreement_status_text` equals `Accepted`.
21. Tap `review_submit_button`. Verify the confirm dialog: `review_confirm_dialog` visible.
22. Tap `review_confirm_submit_button`.
23. Wait for Result: `result_title_text` equals `Demo Limit Request Submitted`. `result_message_text` equals `Your demo request was submitted successfully`. `result_retry_button` is **not** visible. `result_icon_image` content-desc = `Success`.
24. Tap `result_back_home_button`. Verify Dashboard Home is shown again.

test_steps: Launch the application and wait for the splash screen to transition.
Tap the 'NEXT TIME' button on the version check screen.
Enter the username into the login field.
Enter the password into the login field.
Tap the 'LOG IN' button to proceed to OTP.
OTP DETECTED: Read the code from the MOBILE_OTP environment variable at runtime. Enter the first digit of the OTP.
Enter the second digit of the OTP.
Enter the third digit of the OTP.
Enter the fourth digit of the OTP.
Enter the fifth digit of the OTP.
Enter the sixth digit of the OTP.
Tap the 'VERIFY' button to complete MFA.
Tap 'ACCEPT' on the legal terms popup.
Tap 'LATER' on the reminder popup.
Tap 'NOT NOW' on the notifications enablement popup.
Tap the hamburger menu button on the dashboard.
Tap the 'Increase Limit' option in the menu.
Select the card ending in '**** 1234' from the list.
Enter the requested limit value of 7500.
Tap 'CONTINUE' to proceed to the agreement screen.
Tap the checkbox to accept the demo agreement.
Tap 'CONTINUE' to proceed to the review screen.
Tap 'SUBMIT' on the review screen.
Tap 'SUBMIT' on the confirmation dialog.
Tap 'BACK TO HOME' to return to the dashboard.
